name: Hall of Supreme Harmony
description: The Hall of Supreme Harmony, commonly known as the Jinluan Hall, is the essence of ancient Chinese palace architecture. It is one of the three largest palaces in the East and the largest existing wooden structure in China. It is located in a prominent position on the north-south main axis of the Forbidden City in Beijing. It is the largest, highest-level, and largest building in the Forbidden City. It is mainly used for holding grand ceremonies, such as the emperor's coronation, the emperor's wedding, etc. The interior and exterior decorations of the main hall are gorgeous and resplendent. There is a wide platform in front of the hall. The decoration inside the hall is the best in the history of Han palace architecture, demonstrating its supreme status.
